lines.text: Yesterday I whispered, today I’m finding my voice
Every fear I buried, I’m giving it no choice
I’ve been quiet too long, holding back the fight
Now I’m rising stronger, stepping into the light
The volume’s turning up inside my chest
This time I’m louder than the rest
Louder than yesterday, hear me roar
Stronger than the pain I felt before
I’m not holding back, this is my song
Louder than yesterday, where I belong
They tried to dim my sparkle, but the fire’s still alive
Every scar’s a story, every tear helped me survive
I’m rewriting every rule they said was true
Now the world is gonna hear me breaking through
The volume’s turning up inside my chest
This time I’m louder than the rest
Louder than yesterday, hear me roar
Stronger than the pain I felt before
I’m not holding back, this is my song
Louder than yesterday, where I belong
